changes: Conservative per-node cross-feature raw-gain screening for wide scalar batches; uncertain and tied candidates retained.
Scalar split kernels read immutable histogram-cache segments directly, removing the gathered copy.
Common-cut diagnostic option and wide/exhaustive regression coverage.

dataset.generator: numpy.default_rng(1701); FP32 normal features; noisy logistic target

signal.formula: 2/sqrt(k) * sum((-1)**i * t_i); t_i=(x[f_i]**2-1)/sqrt(2) for i%4==0, otherwise x[f_i]

quality_diagnosis.interpretation: On this workload the CPU/MPS quality difference follows quantile cuts. Both shared-cut directions give identical split structure and small leaf-rounding differences. No production sketch/precision/tolerance changes and no NVIDIA execution.

benchmark_method: Fresh process per run, runtime warmed; 100 rounds, depth 6, 256 bins. Training includes quantization and held-out evaluation. Data generation, DMatrix construction and final prediction are separate. Three rotated CPU/baseline/candidate orders; no project builds/tests overlapped.
limitations: Other applications, temperature and system-wide paging were not controlled. This was a busy machine; individual timings and system swap observations are retained.
GPU-family counters may overlap and must not be summed as wall time.
Source-derived cut/split checks and same-model CPU prediction are not NVIDIA execution evidence.
